name: MPF Volume Rendering
definition: A volume rendering technique using Metric-Phase Fields (MPFs) where opacity is derived from a signed composite field φ via a NeuS-style mapping, while color is predicted by a separate radiance network. This isolates the geometry backbone replacement (SDF to MPF) and handles sign-ambiguous geometry.
summary: MPF Volume Rendering is a neural technique using Metric-Phase Fields to handle sign-ambiguous geometry and thin structures better than standard SDFs.
